verdict.rationale: Undermind documents an official hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp) with setup instructions for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Copilot and any MCP-compatible client. It exposes documented tools for deep literature review, full-text PDF reading, search, and workspace notes, and a probe confirms the official MCP page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: claude mcp add --transport http undermind https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp
Undermind works with any MCP-compatible client.
